nodes.label: Team.run(task)
nodes.desc: run_stream spins up an embedded SingleThreadedAgentRuntime, registers participants plus a group chat manager, and sends GroupChatStart to the manager.

nodes.label: RoundRobinGroupChat / SelectorGroupChat / Swarm
nodes.desc: User-facing team classes that only differ in their manager's select_speaker policy: cyclic index, model-based vote, or handoff following.

nodes.label: BaseGroupChatManager
nodes.desc: A dedicated manager actor: applies the termination condition after every turn, then requests the next speaker via GroupChatRequestPublish.

nodes.label: SingleThreadedAgentRuntime
nodes.desc: The actor runtime: one asyncio.Queue of message envelopes, an intervention gate, lazy agent factories, and publish/subscribe plus RPC delivery.

nodes.label: TypeSubscription
nodes.desc: Binds a topic type to an agent type; get_subscribed_recipients(topic_id) uses it to fan publishes out to matching agents.

nodes.label: ChatAgentContainer
nodes.desc: Actor shell wrapped around every chat agent: buffers the shared thread, runs agent.on_messages_stream on request, publishes the Response back.

nodes.label: AssistantAgent
nodes.desc: The workhorse agent: builds model context, streams LLM output, executes tool calls in a bounded loop, and can reflect on tool use.

nodes.label: ChatCompletionClient
nodes.desc: Provider-agnostic create/create_stream contract over LLMMessage sequences, returning CreateResult with usage stats.

nodes.label: OpenAIChatCompletionClient
nodes.desc: Concrete client from the Extensions package; anthropic, ollama, azure and cached variants live beside it in autogen-ext.models.

nodes.label: BaseTool / Workbench
nodes.desc: BaseTool exposes name, description and a pydantic args schema; Workbench generalizes execution to MCP-style tool services.

nodes.label: Memory protocol
nodes.desc: update_context() lets pluggable memory stores inject retrieved MemoryContent into the model context before each call.

nodes.label: TerminationCondition
nodes.desc: Composable stop checks: MaxMessageTermination, TextMentionTermination, TokenUsageTermination combine with & and | into one StopMessage decision.
